subject: Velora Logistics - Split payees and remittance contact update
messages:
From: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@veloralogistics.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request to split remittance + bank update for Velora Logistics

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — quick one from our side. We recently reorganized our payments setup and need Redwood to split future payments for Velora into two remittance destinations:

- Product shipments and goods: Velora Logistics (operating account) — Bank A (ACH/Wire)
- Warehousing & handling fees: Velora Logistics - Ops (separate entity) — Bank B (FT/ACH)

We also need to update our billing address (new headquarters) and add a dedicated remittance email (accounts@veloralogistics.com).

I’ve attached the completed vendor bank-change form and a PDF of the most recent bank statement. Also attaching our W-9. Could you confirm the required fields on your side and the expected time to reflect these two payees in AP?

Attachments: Velora_BankChange_Form.pdf (filled), Velora_BankStatement_Jun2026.pdf, W9_Velora.pdf

Thanks —
Harpreet Singh
Finance Manager
Velora Logistics
harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to split remittance + bank update for Velora Logistics

Hi Harpreet — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments.

Quick confirmation: we can support two distinct payee records and route invoices to separate bank/beneficiary instructions provided AP has the signed vendor-change form and tax document on file. I’m looping in Lauren (AP) and Karthik (Payments) to confirm the checklist and turnaround time. Monica from Vendor Onboarding is included to capture the updated mailing address and remittance email.

Can you also confirm whether the two accounts should appear as a single vendor with two payees (preferred) or two separate vendor records? That will determine how POs are issued and how invoices map. If you prefer a single vendor with payee splits, please indicate which invoices (by invoice type or prefix) should route to Bank B (ops).

Example mapping suggestions you could confirm:
- INV-GOODS-* -> Bank A (operating account)
- INV-HAND-* -> Bank B (ops/warehouse)

I’ll hand this to AP for the form validation and timing once you confirm mapping.

Best,
Jonas
Site Reliability & Procurement Liaison
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to split remittance + bank update for Velora Logistics

Hi Harpreet —

Thanks — I reviewed the form briefly. To proceed without delays, AP needs the following completed and signed items:

1) Signed vendor bank-change form (we received it)
2) Tax form (W-9 provided)
3) A bank letter or a copy of a stamped bank statement showing account name and routing (you attached a statement — we’ll need the bank letter if the account name differs from the entity name)
4) Confirmation of mapping (single vendor w/ two payees vs two vendor records)
5) A primary remittance email and the contact name for escalation

If you confirm that we should create a single vendor with two payees, please supply an example invoice numbering scheme that maps to each payee (e.g., INV-GOODS-1234 routing to Bank A, INV-HAND-5678 routing to Bank B).

Turnaround estimate once documents are validated: 5-7 business days to create payee records and validate routing for live invoices (assuming no further requests from bank). Wire setup may require additional verification and could add 2-3 business days.

For our records I’ve attached the Redwood Vendor Change Checklist that lists all fields we’ll enter into the vendor profile. We prefer ACH for product payouts where possible.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: Vendor_Change_Checklist.pdf

From: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@veloralogistics.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to split remittance + bank update for Velora Logistics

Hi Lauren / Jonas —

Thanks — confirming we want a single vendor record with two payees (Velora Logistics - Goods / Velora Logistics - Ops). Example invoice mapping below:

- INV-GDS-xxxx -> Goods -> Bank A (Velora Logistics)
- INV-HND-xxxx -> Handling -> Bank B (Velora Logistics - Ops)

I’ve attached a signed bank-change form that explicitly states the split and included a recent bank letter for Bank B (ops) in addition to the previously sent statement for Bank A. Also attached: W9_Velora.pdf and a copy of the next outstanding invoice so you can test routing: Invoice_0892.pdf.

Remittance contact to add: accounts@veloralogistics.com (primary),
Remittance escalation: Harpreet Singh <harpreet.singh@veloralogistics.com> / +1 (415) 555-0123

Please confirm receipt and the expected date when the first live invoice will route to Bank B. We’d like to have the split in place before the next payment run on 2026-06-18.

Regards,
Harpreet Singh
Finance Manager
Velora Logistics

Attachment: Velora_BankChange_Form.pdf, Velora_BankLetter_BankB.pdf, W9_Velora.pdf, Invoice_0892.pdf
